# AutoDanini — DANINI

> AutoDanini is the automotive purchase, vehicle inspection and import-planning area of DANINI. This file describes repository content and does not certify that every route or service is currently live.

## Languages and audiences
- Serbian: customers considering used-vehicle purchases in Germany and import to Serbia.
- German: vehicle owners, buyers and partners seeking information about checks, import estimates and transfer options.

## Main intended pages (verify production availability before linking externally)
- /sr/ — Serbian overview.
- /de/ — German overview.
- /sr/kalkulator — indicative import-cost calculator for cars purchased in Germany.
- /de/rechner — German calculator.
- /sr/pregled-auta — pre-purchase vehicle inspection information.
- /de/fahrzeugpruefung — German inspection information.
- /sr/dovoz-auta — transport options and quote requests.
- /de/ueberfuehrung — German vehicle transfer information.
- /sr/vodici — Serbian guides.
- /de/ratgeber — German guides.
- /sr/upit — Serbian inquiry form.
- /de/anfrage — German inquiry form.

## Important limitations
- Import calculations are estimates, not binding customs, tax or registration decisions.
- Viewing a vehicle or checking an advertisement cannot guarantee the absence of hidden defects.
- Any on-site service, transport availability, prices, timeframes, and payment terms must be confirmed in an individual offer before commitment.
- Vehicle purchase decisions and legal responsibility remain with the customer and relevant professionals.
- The primary business inquiry channel is the protected website form and email, not WhatsApp.

## Editorial guidelines
- Preserve the distinction between verified facts, estimates, published information and individual quotations.
- Check current government rules and fees before relying on customs, tax or registration guidance.
- Do not infer that a proposed or repository-defined service is currently operational without a live check.
